info.description: EORA Suite API v1 (doc 24, ADR-0013). Errors are RFC 9457 problem+json; quantities are decimal strings. B0 exposes health endpoints only.

get.summary:
Members of the active tenant with their unrevoked assignments (`effective` = inside the validity window now).
Assignments are limited to the caller's view scopes as query predicates (doc 18 §5): a company- or plant-scoped
administrator sees only assignments inside its company/plant. Member identities are tenant-wide by design (the
`users` policy already shows every member of the active tenant, doc 25 §2.2) so a scoped administrator can
still pick whom to grant

The switch is recorded as security event `workspace.tenant_selected` of the chosen tenant before the session
changes: no record, no switch. When exactly one plant is in the user's scope it becomes the active plant at once
(D-071), recorded as `workspace.plant_selected` with detail `SOLE_PLANT` in the same transaction.

post.summary:
Forgot password (doc 25 §2.3): always 202 with the same body and headers after a fixed minimum duration (D-B1-21:
400 ms), so whether the email exists, is throttled or was queued is not observable (T-RST-07, T-RSTU-10). The HTTP
limits (3/min per email HMAC, 10/min per IP) run here rather than as throttle middleware, which would answer 429
or add rate-limit headers

A degraded dependency is an expected answer, not an error: 503 with the same body shape and `status: degraded`.
`version` (ok) and `error` (fail) are omitted in production.

post.summary:
Invite by e-mail. The identity is resolved first on the auth connection (`auth_api.invite_identity`: existing
e-mail → existing user, otherwise a password-less identity); then the INVITED membership and an INITIAL dispatch
request are written in this tenant transaction. Inviting grants no access; roles are assigned separately
